_comment: Blog posts queued to go live automatically. The workflow .github/workflows/publish-scheduled-post.yml runs each morning and publishes any post whose publish_on date has arrived, at 8:00 AM America/New_York. Once a post is published its entry is removed from this list automatically. To queue a new post: write the post file in blog/ with the noindex line, then add an entry here.

posts.title: ServiceTitan Just Restricted AI Agent Access. Property Management Software Is Next.
posts.description: ServiceTitan restricted AI agent access and banned credential sharing. What the new terms actually say, why Podium got cut off, and what it means for property management.
